candidate_exposure.custody: Self-custodied. Claude (Opus 5.5, in Tim Hulshof's project) designed the method, prepares the inputs and will run the evaluation; no external custodian. Separation rests on recorded order: this method freeze (git commit + Claude project record), then panel A inputs (media, carbon sources, base models, adjudication packets and decisions) and an inputs freeze, then the first download of panel A fitness tables.
candidate_exposure.uninspected_evidence: Since the method freeze, panel A experiment metadata were read for medium names, aerobic flags and carbon-source condition names (mapping only); no fitness table of any panel organism has been downloaded. This inputs freeze precedes the first download.

question: Do fitness-blind, annotation-driven corrections (U') and blind AI adjudication of gene rules (M) improve EMBL GEMs draft-model predictions of carbon-source gene fitness on six organisms not used in development?
decision_rule: Supported if the mean difference is positive and the organism-bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero; not supported if the mean is zero or negative; inconclusive otherwise. Every organism and every arm is reported, including failures.
inputs_note: Panel A inputs prepared under the frozen method: media mapped by rule (R2A undefined, excluded); 16 new carbon-source names mapped; reference conditions chosen by rule; base models gap-filled for Cola (not needed), Dino, Dyella79, MycoTube (not needed), RPal_CGA009 (gap-fill added a nitrate reductase: the trace nitrate of cobalt nitrate is an unlimited ion under the frozen media rule); PS failed (every gap-fill solution created an energy-generating cycle) and is not evaluable; blind adjudication of the five others (265 candidates: 25 R6, 2 R2, 76 R1, 162 abstain; all applicable).
